name: io.github.tantn89/warehouse-mcp
title: Warehouse MCP
description: Governed read-only warehouse access for agents: SQL guard, row policies, PII pseudonyms, audit log.

packageArguments.name: --demo
packageArguments.description: Serve the bundled Wikipedia demo (no setup). Use --config <file> for your own warehouse instead.

environmentVariables.name: WAREHOUSE_MCP_POSTGRES_DSN
environmentVariables.description: Postgres connection string of a read-only role (Postgres configs only).

environmentVariables.name: WAREHOUSE_MCP_PII_SALT
environmentVariables.description: Fixed salt for stable pseudonyms across restarts (16-128 letters or digits).

environmentVariables.name: WAREHOUSE_MCP_AUDIT_LOG
environmentVariables.description: Path of the JSONL audit log; stderr when unset.
